officialTitle: Durvalumab plus platinum-etoposide versus platinum-etoposide in first-line treatment of extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer (CASPIAN): a randomised, controlled, open-label, phase 3 trial

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: Between March 27, 2017, and May 29, 2018, 972 patients were screened and 805 were randomly assigned (268 to durvalumab plus tremelimumab plus platinum-etoposide, 268 to durvalumab plus platinum-etoposide, and 269 to platinum-etoposide).
design.notes: Three-arm 1:1:1 randomisation. Control arm allowed up to six cycles of platinum-etoposide and optional PCI; immunotherapy arms received up to four cycles of platinum-etoposide with durvalumab, then maintenance durvalumab.

clinicalQuestion: Does adding durvalumab (with or without tremelimumab) to platinum-etoposide improve overall survival in untreated extensive-stage SCLC?

pico.population: Adults with untreated extensive-stage SCLC, WHO PS 0-1
pico.intervention: Durvalumab plus platinum-etoposide (cisplatin or carboplatin), then maintenance durvalumab; a third arm added tremelimumab
pico.comparator: Platinum-etoposide alone (up to six cycles, optional PCI)

arms.label: Durvalumab + EP
arms.regimen: Durvalumab + etoposide + cisplatin or carboplatin, then maintenance durvalumab
arms.dosing: Etoposide 80-100 mg/m2 days 1-3 with carboplatin AUC 5-6 or cisplatin 75-80 mg/m2 day 1; durvalumab 1500 mg every 3 weeks for up to four cycles, then durvalumab 1500 mg every 4 weeks
arms.doseSourceQuote: Platinum-etoposide consisted of etoposide 80-100 mg/mon days 1-3 of each cycle with investigator's choice of either carboplatin area under the curve 5-6 mg/mL per min or cisplatin 75-80 mg/m(administered on day 1 of each cycle). Patients received up to four cycles of platinum-etoposide plus durvalumab 1500 mg with or without tremelimumab 75 mg every 3 weeks followed by maintenance durvalumab 1500 mg every 4 weeks in the immunotherapy groups

arms.label: Durvalumab + tremelimumab + EP
arms.regimen: Durvalumab + tremelimumab + platinum-etoposide, then maintenance durvalumab
arms.dosing: As durvalumab + EP with tremelimumab 75 mg every 3 weeks during induction
arms.doseSourceQuote: Patients received up to four cycles of platinum-etoposide plus durvalumab 1500 mg with or without tremelimumab 75 mg every 3 weeks followed by maintenance durvalumab 1500 mg every 4 weeks in the immunotherapy groups

arms.label: EP alone
arms.regimen: Platinum-etoposide (up to six cycles) with optional PCI

publications.title: Durvalumab plus platinum-etoposide versus platinum-etoposide in first-line treatment of extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer (CASPIAN): a randomised, controlled, open-label, phase 3 trial.
publications.label: Planned interim analysis (durvalumab + EP vs EP)

publications.title: Durvalumab, with or without tremelimumab, plus platinum-etoposide versus platinum-etoposide alone in first-line treatment of extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer (CASPIAN): updated results from a randomised, controlled, open-label, phase 3 trial.
publications.label: Updated analysis including durvalumab + tremelimumab arm

publications.title: Durvalumab, with or without tremelimumab, plus platinum-etoposide in first-line treatment of extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer: 3-year overall survival update from CASPIAN.
publications.label: 3-year OS update

outcomes.sourceQuote: Durvalumab plus platinum-etoposide was associated with a significant improvement in overall survival, with a hazard ratio of 0·73 (95% CI 0·59-0·91; p=0·0047]); median overall survival was 13·0 months (95% CI 11·5-14·8) in the durvalumab plus platinum-etoposide group versus 10·3 months (9·3-11·2) in the platinum-etoposide group, with 34% (26·9-41·0) versus 25% (18·4-31·6) of patients alive at 18 months.

Durvalumab plus platinum-etoposide showed sustained improvement in overall survival versus platinum-etoposide (HR 0·75 [95% CI 0·62-0·91]; nominal p=0·0032); median overall survival was 12·9 months (95% CI 11·3-14·7) versus 10·5 months (9·3-11·2).

outcomes.analysisLabel: Primary analysis (durvalumab + tremelimumab + EP vs EP)
outcomes.sourceQuote: Durvalumab plus tremelimumab plus platinum-etoposide was not associated with a significant improvement in overall survival versus platinum-etoposide (hazard ratio [HR] 0·82 [95% CI 0·68-1·00]; p=0·045); median overall survival was 10·4 months (95% CI 9·6-12·0) versus 10·5 months (9·3-11·2).

As of 22 March 2021 (median follow-up 39.4 months, 86% maturity), durvalumab plus EP continued to demonstrate improved OS versus EP: hazard ratio (HR) 0.71 [95% confidence interval (CI) 0.60-0.86; nominal P = 0.0003]; median OS was 12.9 versus 10.5 months, and 36-month OS rate was 17.6% versus 5.8%.

safety.description: Any-cause grade 3 or 4 adverse events (durvalumab + EP vs EP)
safety.sourceQuote: Any-cause adverse events of grade 3 or 4 occurred in 163 (62%) of 265 treated patients in the durvalumab plus platinum-etoposide group and 166 (62%) of 266 in the platinum-etoposide group; adverse events leading to death occurred in 13 (5%) and 15 (6%) patients.

safety.description: Adverse events leading to death (durvalumab + EP vs EP)
safety.sourceQuote: adverse events leading to death occurred in 13 (5%) and 15 (6%) patients.

strengths: Large randomised phase III trial allowing either cisplatin or carboplatin
Long-term OS updates show sustained benefit for durvalumab plus EP
limitations: Control arm permitted up to six chemotherapy cycles and PCI, whereas PCI was not given in the immunotherapy arms
Adding tremelimumab did not significantly improve OS

clinicalImplications.text: Established durvalumab plus platinum-etoposide followed by durvalumab maintenance as a first-line standard for extensive-stage SCLC, with flexibility to use cisplatin or carboplatin; dual checkpoint blockade added no significant benefit.

tumourBoardPearl.text: CASPIAN permitted cisplatin as the platinum partner, which can be relevant when carboplatin is not preferred; tremelimumab should not be added.
